description: Decode IDs: Snowflake, MongoDB ObjectId, KSUID, TypeID, ULID, UUID and CUID2 — timestamp, machine fields and randomness. Operations: "decode" — Detect each ID's format and take it apart (one ID per line, up to 200).. Call with "operation" plus "input" (and "options" where relevant).

input.description: One or more IDs, one per line.

operation.description: decode — Detect each ID's format and take it apart (one ID per line, up to 200).

options.description: Options for the chosen operation (each says which operations use it).

epoch.description: Which epoch to read Snowflake IDs with. Used by: decode.

kind.description: Force a format instead of detecting it from the shape. Used by: decode.

name: id-decoder
title: ID Decoder
